name: manual_51e864
claim: When validating a persisted schema compare the normalized stored DDL text, not only column and index names; CREATE IF NOT EXISTS silently accepts a pre-existing file with weaker constraints.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: name-only validation would have blessed a database with the right columns but no UNIQUE or a weaker partial-index predicate.

rationale: 2026-10-19: name-only validation would have blessed a database with the right columns but no UNIQUE or a weaker partial-index predicate.
